briefdescription.para: Spawn a child protothread, continuing across PT_MORE chunks until another task needs the CPU or the child yields PT_IDLE / exits.

detaileddescription.para: When uncontended (!syn_task_should_share(task)), consecutive PT_MORE chunks from func execute back-to-back in a single scheduler dispatch without context-switch overhead. The moment a peer task requires CPU time, yields PT_MORE and resumes the child from its saved continuation on the next turn.

briefdescription.para: Cooperative scheduler for protothread tasks.

detaileddescription.para: The scheduler manages an array of SYN_Task descriptors. Each call to syn_sched_run() dispatches one eligible task using a ranked policy: Overdue (starvation bound reached) -> Work (PT_MORE) -> Poll (unpolled this round) -> Round reset (all ready tasks passed). Within every rank, tasks are ordered by priority and then round-robin.

Every eligible task runs within max_wait_ms[prio] plus the duration of the currently executing cooperative chunk plus any higher-priority overdue tasks ahead of it (soft bound; hard latency belongs in ISRs).
